headword: {常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}
reading: じょうりょくこうようじゅ

definitions.explanation: A broadleaf tree that keeps its leaves year-round, as opposed to a deciduous broadleaf tree. Common in warmer parts of Japan and at shrines, such as {椎|しい} and {楠|くすのき}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{椎|しい}→椎：30885_shii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}だ。
examples.english: The shii is a representative evergreen broadleaf tree.

examples.japanese: {常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧をつけている。
examples.english: Evergreen broadleaf trees keep green leaves year-round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{西日本|にしにほん}→西日本：27538_nishinihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Evergreen broadleaf trees are common in the forests of western Japan.

notes:
{常緑|じょうりょく} (evergreen) + ⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧ (broadleaf tree): a broadleaf tree that keeps its leaves year-round instead of shedding them. ⟦{椎|しい}→椎：30885_shii⟧ and ⟦{楠|くすのき}→楠：30886_kusunoki⟧ are typical examples, common at shrines and in warmer regions of Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}→落葉広葉樹：30887_rakuyoukouyouju⟧: deciduous broadleaf tree — sheds its leaves seasonally instead of keeping them year-round
- ⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧: the broader category covering both evergreen and deciduous broadleaf trees
